scene_zh: 一家城区健身房的到店与月度人次（模拟数据）

views.subject: Gym check-ins by hour
views.subtitle_en: Average check-ins per hour, by day and time.

examples.en: Tuesday at 7 p.m. is the busiest hour, with 168 check-ins.
examples.zh: 周二晚上 7 点最忙，每小时 168 人次。

features.note_zh: busiest + 时段 是口语里最自然的说法。
features.interpret_zh: 峰值是周一同一时段的 1.4 倍左右。

examples.en: Sunday at 7 a.m. is the quietest slot, with just eight check-ins.
examples.zh: 周日早上 7 点最冷清，只有 8 人次。

features.note_zh: quietest 形容时段；lowest 一般修饰数值。
features.interpret_zh: 这个时段适合闭馆维护，不占用高峰资源。

examples.en: Weekdays follow the same shape: a small lunch bump and a much larger evening rush.
examples.zh: 工作日走势一致：中午小高峰，傍晚大高峰。

features.note_zh: follow the same shape 说多行形态一致。
features.interpret_zh: 只看周一行不能代表周末，周六周日完全不同。

examples.en: The 7 p.m. column is the darkest across all seven days.
examples.zh: 晚上 7 点这一列在七天里都最深。

features.note_zh: column 和 row 在热力图里分别指时间列和星期行。
features.interpret_zh: 这是最需要人手的时段，也是器械最紧张的时候。

examples.en: Saturday at noon draws 48 check-ins, more than any weekday lunch hour.
examples.zh: 周六中午有 48 人次，高于任何工作日的午间。

features.note_zh: draw + 人数 是描述客流的常用动词。
features.interpret_zh: 周末把高峰从傍晚移到中午，排班要跟着调整。

examples.en: Sunday stays quiet all day, peaking at only 58 check-ins in the early evening.
examples.zh: 周日全天冷清，傍晚最高也只有 58 人次。

features.note_zh: stay + 形容词 说整体状态。
features.interpret_zh: 周日最高值不到周二峰值的一半。

views.overview_zh: 工作日傍晚 6 到 8 点是绝对高峰，周二晚上 7 点最高；周六高峰移到中午，周日全天最低。早上 7 点几乎没人，是维护和排班调整的窗口。

general.a2: The gym is busiest in the evening on weekdays. Tuesday at 7 p.m. has the most check-ins, 168. Sunday morning at 7 a.m. is the quietest time, with only eight. Weekends move the busiest hours to midday.
general.b1: Weekday traffic peaks between 6 and 8 p.m., with Tuesday at 7 p.m. reaching 168 check-ins. Weekends are different: Saturday peaks around noon, while Sunday stays quiet all day, starting at just eight check-ins.
general.b2: The week has two distinct shapes. Weekdays build slowly, with a small lunch bump, then surge after 6 p.m., peaking on Tuesday at 168 check-ins. Saturday shifts demand to midday, and Sunday is the quietest day, starting at eight check-ins at 7 a.m.

descriptions.ielts: Gym attendance was highest on weekday evenings, peaking at 168 check-ins on Tuesday at 7 p.m. At weekends the pattern changed, with Saturday busiest around noon. Sunday recorded the lowest figure, at eight check-ins at 7 a.m.
descriptions.business: Weekday evenings between 6 and 8 p.m. carry the load, so staffing and equipment should peak there. Saturday's midday demand is a separate pattern worth a smaller shift, and Sunday morning is the safe window for maintenance.

views.subject: Gym visits
views.subtitle_en: Monthly visits in thousands, January to December.

examples.en: Visits bottomed out in February at 24,100.
examples.zh: 到店人次在二月触底，为 24,100 人次。

features.note_zh: bottom out 常配 at + 数值。
features.interpret_zh: 二月低谷与春节假期重合，但图里没有节假日信息。

examples.en: October was the strongest month, with 35,100 visits.
examples.zh: 十月最强，到店 35,100 人次。

features.note_zh: strongest month 是商业描述，比 highest 更自然。
features.interpret_zh: 十月峰值比二月低谷高约 46%。

examples.en: Visits jumped from 24,100 in February to 30,200 in March.
examples.zh: 到店人次从二月的 24,100 跳到三月的 30,200。

features.note_zh: jump 暗示单月大幅回升。
features.interpret_zh: 一个月增长约 25%，是全年最快的上升。

examples.en: Visits climbed steadily from 29,800 in August to 34,200 in September.
examples.zh: 到店人次从八月的 29,800 稳步升到九月的 34,200。

features.note_zh: climb steadily 说连续几期的稳定上升。
features.interpret_zh: 秋季回升持续到十月，九月只是中段。

examples.en: Visits fell from 33,400 in November to 26,900 in December.
examples.zh: 到店人次从十一月的 33,400 跌到十二月的 26,900。

features.note_zh: fall from ... to ... 中性，不强调突然。
features.interpret_zh: 十二月比十月峰值少了 8,200 人次。

examples.en: June's 33,800 visits slipped to 30,600 in July.
examples.zh: 六月 33,800 人次，七月小幅回落到 30,600。

features.note_zh: slip 表示小幅下滑，语气比 plunge 轻。
features.interpret_zh: 夏季回落不到 10%，随后又恢复上升。

views.overview_zh: 全年到店人次在 24,100 到 35,100 之间：二月最低，三月快速回升，十月最高，十二月明显回落。月度趋势要和一周热力图结合看排班。

general.a2: Gym visits were lowest in February and highest in October. They rose through the spring, stayed high in early fall, and dropped sharply in December.
general.b1: Monthly visits ranged from 24,100 in February to 35,100 in October. After a strong spring, numbers dipped in July and August, then climbed to the October peak before falling to 26,900 in December.
general.b2: Visits followed a seasonal curve, from a February low of 24,100 to an October peak of 35,100. The summer dip was modest, but the December drop of 8,200 visits was the sharpest decline of the year.

descriptions.ielts: Gym visits were lowest in February, at 24,100, and highest in October, at 35,100. Numbers rose sharply in March, dipped slightly in July, and fell to 26,900 in December.
descriptions.business: October's 35,100 visits mark the annual peak, while December drops to 26,900. The summer dip is shallow, so the real planning risk is the year-end fall, and retention offers should land before November.
